maddeler.e:
نحتمل (form VIII)
# نَحْتَمِلُ (naḥtamilu) /naħ.ta.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# نُحْتَمَلُ (nuḥtamalu) /nuħ.ta.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# نَحْتَمِلَ (naḥtamila) /naħ.ta.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# نُحْتَمَلَ (nuḥtamala) /nuħ.ta.ma.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
